title: Temporary datasets (&&name) passed between steps with DISP=(NEW,PASS)
shapes: BDLD BDLDNITE.jcl: SORT010 writes &&SORTED with DISP=(NEW,PASS); LOAD020 reads it with DISP=(OLD,DELETE)
asserts: A DD on a && name is a jcl_dds fact with temp true and no jcl_datasets row: a temporary dataset is not a catalogued dataset and must not appear as one (a phantom on jcl_datasets records it).

citations.section: Identification of data set > Temporary data sets
citations.quote: A temporary data set is a data set that is created and deleted in the same job

phantoms.why: a temporary data set (&&name) exists only for the job: it is not a dataset of the estate
